- List up to 5 current marketing strategy points, only those the evidence states. Fewer or none is fine.

Each gap starts from an activity or audience a cited passage states, then names what did not appear in the sources reviewed, e.g. "Active Instagram influencer program [1] aimed at Gen Z [2]; no TikTok activity appeared in the sources reviewed."
